summary: Tested new premium home-hero redesign (feat/premium-home-and-summary-fixes pull) — HomeHero carousel, 'Choose your workspace' grid (now actually 5 cards: ClinicFlow, SuperSummary, SuperMemory, MoProPrep, DnbProPrep), Profile modal, footer, and regression on ClinicFlow consultation flow + SuperSummary template screen + offline/no-API-key handling. All core flows work with no console errors. App is 100% client-side, no backend calls made (as expected).

integration_issues.issue: Clicking this card does NOT open a distinct SuperMemory feature/page — it calls the same setProduct('clinicalmind') handler as the ClinicFlow card, landing on the ClinicFlow consultation screen (where a 'SuperMemory' side-panel/'Manage Books & Tags' widget happens to be visible). This is not a bug/crash, but is misleading: user clicks 'Open SuperMemory' expecting a memory/search feature and instead lands on the full ClinicFlow library screen. Documenting as requested — not blocking.

action_items: data-testid attributes are ENTIRELY MISSING from the new files: HomeHero.jsx, and confirmed 0 present anywhere on the ClinicFlow consultation screen, complaint library, home cards, profile menu/modal, and SuperSummary screen (verified via document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid]').length === 0 on multiple screens). Previous session's testid work was fully overwritten by this pull as expected/warned. Recommend re-adding data-testid to: workspace cards, Launch/Open/Play buttons, hero dots, profile avatar button + modal, complaint cards, Start Consultation button, Generate Note button, age/sex inputs, Q&A answer buttons.

Consider clarifying UX copy on the 'Open SuperMemory' card since it does not lead to a dedicated SuperMemory page — either build a dedicated landing view or adjust the CTA wording so it's clear it opens ClinicFlow with the reference/tag library panel.
critical_code_review_comments: App.jsx is 3011 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline; recommend splitting ProfileMenu, LibraryScreen, and the home/workspace-grid JSX block out into separate component files, especially since HomeHero.jsx was already split out successfully as a pattern to follow.

'SuperMemory' and 'ClinicFlow' cards on the home grid share the exact same onClick handler (setProduct('clinicalmind')) — functionally these are duplicate entry points; worth confirming this is intentional per product design vs. an oversight where SuperMemory was meant to route to something distinct.
claude.js confirmed unused/unimported per problem statement context — no build errors observed, consistent with instruction to ignore.
test_credentials: None required - app works offline without API key, as designed
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified in this pass: (1) HomeHero carousel renders 4 slides, auto-advances every 5s, dots are clickable and navigate correctly, no console errors. (2) 5 workspace cards render (ClinicFlow, SuperSummary, SuperMemory, MoProPrep, DnbProPrep) each with a CardCarousel of illustrated SVG slides cycling every 3.2s without layout breakage. (3) Footer renders at bottom with Telegram link and copyright, no broken layout. (4) Profile avatar top-right opens a dropdown (View Profile / Tag Library / Settings) -> View Profile opens a clean ProfileModal (Attending Doctor, on-device-only + v1.0 badges, Open Settings button) with no console errors. (5) Launch ClinicFlow -> full complaint library loads (System/Private/Community/AI Mode tabs), selecting a complaint + age/sex + Start Consultation -> live Q&A flow works, differentials panel updates dynamically per answer, red-flag SuperTags panel renders, Generate Note correctly stays disabled until enough Q&A completed. AI Mode tab renders the premium purple 'Fully AI-Controlled Mode' panel correctly with 'Requires an API key' notice - no crash. (6) Launch SuperSummary -> Template Library loads with Public/My Templates/Community/AI Mode tabs, 'No API key' banner shown clearly (graceful degradation, not a crash) with 'Add API key' link to Settings. (7) Open SuperMemory click -> lands on ClinicFlow screen (same handler as ClinicFlow card) - see integration_issues note above, not a crash just a UX/naming mismatch. (8) MoProPrep 'Play & Learn' opens a new tab correctly to https://www.moproprep.in/ (verified via page.expect_popup). DnbProPrep card also present with external link pattern (not click-tested but same code pattern, low risk). (9) Zero data-testid attributes found anywhere in new HomeHero.jsx/App.jsx code -- confirmed via DOM query, flagged as action item. No red console errors observed on any of the tested screens/flows.
rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable - no crashing bugs found. The only notable finding (SuperMemory card routing to ClinicFlow instead of a distinct view) is a product/UX design characteristic of the current code (shared onClick handler `() => setProduct('clinicalmind')` on both ClinicFlow and SuperMemory cards in App.jsx ~line 2888), not a runtime error.
